name: Functional Analysis Isomorphism
description: I replaced the geometric interval packing constraints with an isomorphic system of Lebesgue-measurable functions bounded by 1. Interval length becomes the definite integral, interval disjointness becomes pointwise orthogonality (product is zero almost everywhere), and the rightmost endpoint becomes the essential supremum of the support. This preserves the exact additive bounds while requiring the solver to derive them analytically from measure-theoretic properties rather than pattern-matching on geometric lengths.
